Sunshine on the computer encodes the screen with its graphics card, for lower latency and smoother motion. The picture travels straight over the network (UDP) and is always encrypted; when that is not possible, Miffan uses the normal connection. Linux and Mac computers.
Windows computers connect only through Sunshine. Pairing and encryption are set up here; the picture data needs the same local network or Tailscale.
Not installed. Install Sunshine on the computer (see docs.lizardbyte.dev), open https://localhost:47990 there once to create its admin account, then check again.
Installed but not running. Start Sunshine on the computer, then check again.
Sunshine requires encryption for every stream.
